title: Chapter 710 - 710 After Beating Up The Younger One, The Older One Appears!
content:
Chapter 710 - 710 After Beating Up The Younger One, The Older One Appears!

Chapter 710 - 710 After Beating Up the Younger One, the Older One Appears!

710 After Beating Up the Younger One, the Older One Appears!

Lin Fan chatted with Ma Zheng for a while before ending the soul communication.

Then, he opened the system again and focused on the relationship between the characters.

[Liero: Bug Queen. Level-five Universe. Because you destroyed her plan on Qing Planet, she became angry out of embarrassment and developed hatred toward you. Current hatred points: Five stars.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan frowned.

Liero was obviously the Bug Queen.

In the past, Lin Fan did not pay too much attention to his relationships with people. As a result, he did not know that he had a five-star enemy.

Now, even though Liero had yet to find trouble with him, that was only because he did not know where Lin Fan was.

Lin Fan knew that one day, he would find him.

Since that was the case, why not make the first move?

Lin Fan’s gaze turned cold.

Then, his gaze fell on Curse and the King-Level Technique Upgrade Gem.

[Do you want to upgrade Curse?]

“Yes!”

[Ding! Upgrade successful. Curse is now at the King-level.]

[Do you wish to spend 100,000 spirit stones to curse Liero?]

“Yes!”

Instantly, the 100,000 spirit stones that had been stored in the inner space shattered into pieces and disappeared into a stream of light.

…

On the other hand…

A giant monster swept out with a terrifying aura as it charged forward wantonly, emitting a series of rumbling sounds.

“Ma Zheng, there’s no need to hide. You can’t escape!”

That pair of scarlet eyes were like the cold moon as they swaying in the void.

A terrifying energy continuously surged in all directions.

In the next moment, the monster suddenly caught sight of a figure moving on a meteorite in the distance.

Hence, it grinned and said, “I found you.”

The terrifying aura formed a huge scarlet energy pillar and shot out, directly blasting the meteorite into pieces.

An extremely disheveled figure appeared from the fragment.

It was Ma Zheng.

“I told you, you can’t escape.”

A terrifying pressure pressed down, causing Ma Zheng’s entire body to tremble. He could not think of escaping at all.

It was over.

Beads of sweat kept rolling down.

There was only one thought in Ma Zheng’s mind. He was dead!

At this moment…

A black aura suddenly spread out from Liero’s body.

Her huge body began to twist.

“What’s going on?””

She quickly scanned her surroundings but found nothing.

The next moment, she spat out a mouthful of blood, and her entire face turned pale.

Then, as if she had been frightened, she did not have the mood to pay attention to Ma Zheng at all. She broke through the space and fled rapidly into an unknown distance.

This scene stunned Ma Zheng.

He slowed down for a while before finding a direction and running away again.

…

In the blink of an eye, a month had passed.

For the past month, Lin Fan would curse Liero every day before he started cultivating.

It was the same today.

The 100,000 spirit stones in Lin Fan’s internal space were instantly turned into bubbles.

A crisp voice sounded in his mind.

[Ding! Because of your curse, Liero’s inner demons have greatly increased, her cultivation has greatly decreased, and she’s heavily injured.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan did not pay any more attention to it and started another day of cultivation.

For the next ten days, he kept cursing.

On this day…

[Ding! Because of your curse, Liero has completely perished.]

[Ding! You’ve killed a level-five Universe beast. You’ve obtained 500 million experience points.]

Lin Fan could not help but heave a sigh of relief.

However, at this moment, a clear notification sounded in his mind.

[Ding! You’ve incurred hatred from Liege. Current hatred points: Five stars.]

[Liege: Level-three King expert. Lord of the Bug Realm. Because you have killed his daughter, he has developed hatred toward you. Current hatred points: Five stars.]

Lin Fan frowned.

Was this the legendary saying of beating up the young and then the old?

If this continued, when could he kill them all?

Level-three King!

This was the first time that Lin Fan had met someone with a known cultivation state that was at the King level.

Moreover, he had five stars of hatred toward him.

It was truly troublesome.

Lin Fan said in a low voice, “Liege already knows that I killed his daughter?”

[Do you want to spend 10,000 spirit stones to inquire?]

“Yes!”

[I don’t know.]

Lin Fan continued, “Does he have a way to find out the source of the curse?”

[The curse is protected by the system. No living being can know the source unless the host is exposed.]

When Lin Fan heard that, he heaved a sigh of relief.

After that, he began his cultivation for the day.

The next day, he started cursing again.

Today, the target of his curse had become Liege.

…

Bug Realm.

Liege, who was like a mountain range, suddenly opened his eyes. A terrifying green murderous aura spread out, causing all the plants within a hundred miles to wither and wither.

“Curse?” he said in a rumbling voice. “Humph!”

With a muffled groan, the black gas that had just spread out was directly dispersed.

After that, silence returned.

However, he did not know that this was only the beginning.

Ten days.

One month.

Half a year.

One year!

Two years!

Every day, Liege would be cursed.

He could easily resist the curse once, but after so many days of continuous cursing, it was finally difficult for him to resist.

“Humph!”

With a muffled groan, two streams of blood flowed out of Liege’s black nostrils like spring water.

“Curse! Another curse! Who is it?”

“Flame King?

“Wind King?

“Pine Tree King?

“Damn it!”

The powerful red wind churned wildly, turning everything within a radius of hundreds of kilometers into nothingness.

…

[Ding! Your enemy, Lige, has been cursed by you. His mind has been damaged, and his heart is in turmoil.]

…

Four years later, the curse remained.

Black blood flowed out of Liege’s nose, eyes, mouth, and ears. His huge body seemed to have gone crazy, and his aura became weak.

…

[Ding! Your enemy, Liege, has been cursed by you. He’s heavily injured, and his cultivation has decreased.]

…

Ten years later, the curse continued.

“With my soul, I curse my enemies.”

Liege shouted crazily, his voice reverberating in the universe.

In the next moment…

Liege’s entire body exploded like a balloon, illuminating the entire universe. Terrifying energy waves spread wildly, instantly turning several planets nearby into nothingness.

At this moment, people from countless planets looked at Liege with curiosity, doubt, and horror.

At this moment, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! You’ve killed a level-three King cultivator. You’ve obtained three billion experience points.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve killed a King cultivator for the first time. You’ve obtained Ethereal Breathing Technique (Emperor), Top-Notch Time Laws Talent, and Dark Yellow Protection Pearl (Emperor).]
